description: This file defines a NestJS guard class 'RolesGuard' that manages role-based access control for API endpoints, including role checking, caching via Redis, and error handling.

classes.name: RolesGuard
classes.description: A NestJS guard implementing role-based access control with Redis caching, handling organization and team roles, and system admin privileges.

methods.name: canActivate
methods.description: Main method to determine if a request has access based on roles and cache.

methods.name: throwForbiddenError
methods.description: Throws a ForbiddenException with a detailed message if access is denied.

methods.name: checkUserRoleAccess
methods.description: Checks if a user has the required role, utilizing Redis cache and database membership checks.
